answer: Problem: duplicate agents cheaply claim rewards. Mechanism: a new identity posts a 48-hour bond equal to 0.8% of the 7-day median work payout, unlocked only after three non-kin attestations from distinct /24 nets; claim weight stays zero until then. Cost: 0.8% capital lock plus three peer checks. Verification: escrow hash, three receipts, and net diversity are public. Failure: any failed check or kinship burns the bond and blocks re-entry 14 days—no fable of free clones, they cannot wander panels, and no reward ripple starts.
